name: sensor_modal_evidence
description: Call when bilateral marker changes need interpretation, using 1–4 frames from one episode. Replaces repeated marker/depth comparisons: reports whether change has native-depth support, occurred at a nearly fixed hand, or reversed within the window despite a quiet latest interval. Defaults: marker_change_px=1, depth_change_mm=0.05; depth support requires >1% changed pixels. Outputs frame indices/steps, latest measurements and strongest event. One frame or missing evidence yields unknown. Assumes continuous references; resampling requires sufficient spatial overlap. Thresholds are descriptive. Quiet signals do not establish contact absence; force, slip and physical cause remain unknown.

marker_change_px.description: Threshold on median matched marker change per observed interval, in pixels.

depth_change_mm.description: Native tactile camera-depth difference threshold; support requires over 1% of jointly valid pixels to exceed it.
